remarks: Coastal living meets modern luxury - Experience the best of Stamford's most sought-after shoreline neighborhood. This stunning, newly renovated 2-bedroom, 1.5 bath townhouse offers a bright and airy retreat designed for those who appreciate quality & convenience.  The gourmet kitchen with sleek finishes offers top of the line appliances. The open-concept living and dining area features a cozy fireplace - perfect for chilly New England evenings. Step through the sliding glass door onto your own private deck, ideal for morning coffee or sunset drinks. With hardwood floors throughout and a full size LG washer/dryer right in the unit - living here it easy.  Located in the heart of The Cove, you are minutes away from Cove Island Park. Enjoy walking trails, sandy beaches, tennis courts, and salt-air breezes every single day. Unbeatable location: Whether you're commuting via I-95 or Metro North, or heade downtown for dinner or shopping, everything is just minutes away. This is more than a rental; it's a lifestyle upgrade.
